what: Worked example: adding a variant to a model function
title: Writing new estimation method for inferential statistics
text: LINEAR_REG()’s formula implementation calls stats::lm() weights. Suppose want weighted-least-squares variant. reuses package’s lm_to_lm_object() helper, inherits print(), coefficients, anova() support default: Let’s try simple example: Nothing differs structurally extending test function. left-hand side %<-% names function extended (LINEAR_REG), model shape applies (S7::class_formula), variant’s name ("weighted"); right-hand side ordinary variant() object. %<-% dispatches class left-hand side — add_variant_call — add_variant_register(), validates model_type registers variant key built cls (read LINEAR_REG via "cls" attribute) model type’s name.
